description: A single digital signature extracted from a PDF via pdfsig (poppler-utils). Personal identity numbers are never stored; the raw Distinguished Name is dropped.

number.description: 1-based index of this signature in the document

fieldName.description: PDF form field name that contains the signature

type.description: Signature subtype reported by pdfsig (e.g. ETSI.CAdES.detached, adbe.pkcs7.detached, ETSI.RFC3161)

signedRanges.description: Byte ranges of the document body covered by this signature

totalDocumentSigned.description: True if the signature covers the entire document byte range

validation.description: Raw validation status message from pdfsig
